database: Supabase — MotionGrid leads (SITE_SUPABASE_*) and Autofield app (NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_*)
auth: Custom HMAC session cookies for admin
rules: STRICT: Never use raw hex codes or arbitrary Tailwind values in components.
ALWAYS use design tokens from app/globals.css: text-chrome-100, bg-obsidian, border-hairline, text-signal, etc.
ALWAYS use the brand font variables: font-display (Fraunces), font-sans (Inter), font-mono (JetBrains Mono).
ALWAYS build new UI as reusable components or widgets. Prefer components/ui/ for atoms and components/sections/ for page sections.
When a visual pattern could appear on more than one page, extract it into a reusable component instead of duplicating JSX.
Keep page files thin. Drive lists and navigation from lib/site.ts and lib/technologies.ts, not hardcoded markup.
Define TypeScript props interfaces for every new component and reuse existing types where possible.
Use Server Components by default. Add 'use client' only when necessary.
Use named imports from lucide-react. Never import '* as Icons' from lucide-react.
Keep all Supabase service-role usage in server code only (Server Components / Server Actions / API routes).

All admin Server Actions MUST verify the session before performing authenticated data mutations (authentication actions such as signIn and signOut, which establish or clear SESSION_COOKIE, are exempt).
Never commit secrets, credentials, or session keys to source code.
Use .mg-brushed, .mg-chrome-text, and .mg-eyebrow utilities where the design calls for them.
Mobile-first responsive design: default styles target mobile, then md:/lg: breakpoints.
Mark launch-blockers with TODO and reference README.md checklist.
